infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Pawprint uses the camera so you can photograph street cats. Photos are camera-only and location data is removed.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Pawprint uses your location to show cats nearby. Pins are always shown as approximate areas.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Pawprint lets you choose a cat photo for your private Journal. Gallery photos are not eligible for public pins, XP, or streaks.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Pawprint does not need to save photos to your library.
